# Address-book IDs, shared CSS classes and localization IDs use distinct naming patterns

For new controls in the accepted address-book pane, use lowerCamelCase DOM IDs such as booksPaneCreateContact. Use lower-case dashed shared CSS classes, such as sidebar-panel-header and icon-button, and lower-case dashed Fluent IDs, such as books-pane-create-contact-button. Keep the pane prefix on related IDs so controls can be found as a group. Existing bookRow/noDelete/readOnly classes are legacy exceptions. Do not rename them by inference or claim every Thunderbird ID/class follows one format. This is a proposed scoped convention from accepted code, beyond formatter rules.

Scope: address book naming.

Paths:

- `mail/components/addrbook/content/aboutAddressBook.xhtml`
